Your **pebble-ai** account is on the **Free** plan. Based on the usage records currently visible for **April 1–8 (UTC)**, you’ve used **231,400 billed tokens**:

Free has no overage charges or invoices, so you won’t be charged more for going over the included usage. But once you reach the monthly limit, further requests may be rate-limited until next month; upgrading lets you continue sooner.

I can’t tell from the records available how close you are to that limit—the account data doesn’t show the Free allowance or remaining quota. Check the usage or quota display in your Console to see what the warning means for your remaining usage.
What error will our requests get when that happens?

For your **Free** plan, when you reach the monthly limit, requests are rate-limited with **HTTP 429** and error code **`quota_exceeded`**. The response includes a **`Retry-After`** header; requests work again when the next month starts, unless you upgrade sooner.
What should we do to keep requests running?

To keep requests running after the Free monthly limit is reached, **upgrade the workspace to a paid plan**. Free has no overage, so usage beyond the limit won’t be charged; requests are rate-limited until the next month unless you upgrade sooner.

If you haven’t reached the limit yet, reducing usage can help you stay within it. Check your Console’s plan and quota settings to choose an upgrade.
